findings.title: Init container waits for its own pod
findings.cause: init container wait-for-web waits for Service web, and the only pods behind that Service are Deployment web's own: they serve only once their app containers run, and those start only after this init container exits, so each waits for the other; its log says: "wget: can't connect to remote host (10.96.81.222): Connection refused"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: init container wait-for-web has been running since 2026-11-24T11:10:58Z

evidence.what: Service web selects pods with app=web: the pods of Deployment web, this one included

findings.fix: Remove the wait for web from init container wait-for-web, or point it at what the pod really depends on. A pod cannot wait for itself: its readiness and startup probes are what hold traffic back until the app is up.
